set_aside_reason: OTHER: No confidence interval for the serious-adverse-event comparison is reported in any held source.

population.span: Patients who were 18 years of age or older (with no upper age limit) and who were hospitalized with Covid-19 pneumonia that had been confirmed by a positive polymerase-chain-reaction test and radiographic imaging were eligible for enrollment.

endpoint.span: In the safety population, serious adverse events occurred

estimate.span: In the safety population, serious adverse events occurred in 38 of 250 patients (15.2%) in the tocilizumab group and 25 of 127 patients (19.7%) in the placebo group.

analysis_set.span: Safety was assessed in all the patients who received either tocilizumab or placebo; patients were grouped according to the actual agent received.

treatment_strategy.span: we randomly assigned the patients, in a 2:1 ratio, to receive standard care plus one or two doses of either intravenous tocilizumab (8 mg per kilogram of body weight, to a maximum of 800 mg per dose) or placebo.

follow_up.span: Adverse Events through Day 60 in the Safety Population.

absent_reason: ci: No confidence interval for serious adverse events is stated in any supplied source; an OR and its confidence interval would require calculation from the reported counts.
served_mismatch: The served counts are correct, but the served analysis_set is incorrect: these are safety-population counts grouped by actual treatment received, not modified intention-to-treat counts grouped by randomized assignment. They cover adverse events through day 60.

candidate_rejections.span: In the safety population, serious adverse events occurred in 38 of 250 patients (15.2%) in the tocilizumab group and 25 of 127 patients (19.7%) in the placebo group.
candidate_rejections.why: Reject the served interpretation of these counts as modified intention-to-treat; retain the counts as safety-population evidence.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Eligible participants were hospitalized adults with confirmed COVID-19 pneumonia, within the question's population.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Patients who were 18 years of age or older (with no upper age limit) and who were hospitalized with Covid-19 pneumonia that had been confirmed by a positive polymerase-chain-reaction test and radiographic imaging were eligible for enrollment.

notes: Full-text evidence used. Extraction targets the served serious-adverse-event outcome. No OR or confidence interval was calculated; set-aside reflects the missing CI span, not rejection of the trial.
